scope: Real Electron offscreen renderer (1040x760 DIP, 2x density), synthetic opaque BGRA source at the stated dimensions. Excludes OS capture, native window startup, IPC serialization, clipboard and disk. 3 warmups per screenshot/scroll batch; GIF streams include their first frame. Alternating before/after batches. First-paint timing includes two animation frames and is sensitive to vsync/GC. Pipeline probes use production scroll matching and GIF encoding; hover probes count real pointer-driven canvas size assignments; they do not measure presentation latency or allocated memory.
